note: Flight recorder (REC-19, owner decisions REC-D1 to REC-D4, 2026-10-23). enabled is false: in a normal game no recorder object exists, nothing is written and nothing in the simulation reads this file except World.setup. A test or the headless harness switches it on (FlightRecorder.test_enabled, economy_sim.gd --record DIR). The recorder never draws from any random generator and never mutates game state.
